messages.text:
BL-1754 — A role with a question for another role asks it through a one-shot read-only helper that answers and exits - bb swarmforge/scripts/peer_question.bb --from <role> --to <role> --question <text> runs the target role's own prompts as one print-mode Claude call with file-reading tools only, prints the answer, records the question and answer, and never claims a parcel, drains an intake, starts a tmux session or outlives its answer; a target seat on any other provider is refused by name
What it solves: ## What is wanted
Approval context: New feature file. This is your "an agent can spin an ephemeral other agent if it has a question for it", built as a helper the ASKING role runs, not something the daemon starts. What needs sign-off: it runs the target role's prompts as one read-only Claude call (it can read files, never write, edit…
BL-1754 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1754" (or "reject BL-1754 <reason>") to act.
